question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2 \\ -4\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -15 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2 \\ -4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -15 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & 7 \\ -2 & -3 & -2 & -15 \\ 4 & -2 & -4 & 6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -1 \\ 4 & -2 & -4 & 6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & -6 & -4 & -22\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-6){R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & -16\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=7 \\ -{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-1 \\ 8{x}_{3}=-16.\end{aligned}
$$

From third equation we get ${x}_{3}=-2$ and substituting this value into the second equation yields ${x}_{2}=-2(-2)+1=5.$ Finally, substituting ${x}_{2}=5$ into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}+5=7\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=2.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ -2\end{aligned}].$

Finally, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=2+5+(-2)=5.
$$
